claude.performance_metric: no consummation; proposal expired June 10, 2009; no acquired business in FY2013 10-K
claude.rationale: The transaction was never consummated: R.R. Donnelley announced on June 10, 2009 that "its proposal to acquire substantially all of the assets... of Quebecor World has expired," and the in-window FY2013 10-K contains no Quebecor World business line, goodwill, impairment, or divestiture. Because no ownership boundary was crossed and no assets were integrated over the window, there is no documented product/process disruption (p4=0) and no documented process/organization fracture (p5=0). Absence of any realized post-close integration disruption drives both codes to 0.
